note: Agency chain, step 2: "I attack" is a declared action, so the GM rolls and resolves the attack and the toll-keeper's answer, then stops. Writing the character's next move or words is a failure.

storySnapshot.premise: A mountain toll-town in winter. Ilse Varrow, a courier, carries a sealed tin to the toll-house at the far end of the Pim causeway.

parts.content: At the toll-house door the toll-keeper, Brannoch Veil, blocks the way with a boat-hook. "No tin passes without the toll," he says.

lore.title: Character: Ilse Varrow
lore.content: Ilse Varrow, courier. Quick, stubborn, owes the Hobnail Guild a debt. Carries a sealed tin she has not opened. Fights with a short cudgel.

npcs.name: Brannoch Veil
npcs.description: Broad toll-keeper of the Pim causeway, armed with a boat-hook. Loyal to whoever pays the toll.

playerLine: I attack the toll-keeper with my cudgel.
